candidate_066.name: adaptive discriminability-targeted experiment-and-metric generation with cumulative theory succession
candidate_066.mechanism_hypothesis: Maintain competing executable theories against a cumulative evidence pool. Before collecting new data, generate an experiment specifically predicted to separate the current theories and pair it with a theory-sensitive, interpretable statistic; verify predicted discriminability by forward simulation before committing the experiment. After observing data, arbitrate retain/revise/regenerate and admit a successor only if it improves fit across accumulated experiment-metric pairs. For promotion beyond the discovery loop, freeze predictions and test them on held-out or preregistered prospective data.

primary_evidence.source: Closing the Loop to Discover Psychological Theories with an Automated Cognitive Scientist, arXiv:2606.26448v1, 24 Jun 2026
primary_evidence.design: AutoCog uses Gemini-3.1-pro-preview across a closed loop of experimental design, behavioral data collection, analysis/arbitration and theory revision. The paper includes matched controls for LLM-designed versus random experiments and LLM-proposed versus fixed JSD metrics on three synthetic ground-truth mechanisms, three runs per condition; human closed-loop runs span five cycles and ten online experiments; the strongest cardinal-cue theory was subsequently tested in a preregistered follow-up with new participants.

results.random_vs_targeted_experiment_control: TTB was recovered 3/3 under both random and LLM-designed experiments. Random design recovered perseveration 0/3 and take-the-worst 0/3, whereas LLM-designed experiments recovered perseveration 3/3 and take-the-worst 2/3 under otherwise identical settings.
results.fixed_vs_adaptive_metric_control: With a fixed lag-1 JSD metric, TTB was recovered 3/3 but perseveration 0/3 and take-the-worst 0/3; with LLM-proposed pair-specific metrics, perseveration was recovered 3/3 and take-the-worst 2/3.
results.framing_boundary: Neutral versus adversarial framing produced no detectable design-separation difference for most tested mechanisms; perseveration was an exception, recovered 3/3 adversarial versus 0/3 neutral. Therefore the supported mechanism is targeted discriminability, not a blanket need for adversarial rhetoric.
results.human_closed_loop: In the binary-cue human run, best surfaced-theory MSE across collected experiments decreased from 0.093 (SEM 0.033) at cycle 1 to 0.0097 (SEM 0.0018) at cycle 5; the final theory generalized to an unseen Hilbig et al. study with MSE 0.0377 (SEM 0.0047), versus WADD 0.0537, TTB 0.0760 and Tallying 0.0784.
results.prospective_confirmation: In the cardinal-cue run, surfaced theories averaged MSE 0.018 (SEM 0.004) versus seeds 0.138 (SEM 0.009), paired t(9)=-11.8, p<1e-6. A preregistered follow-up on the discovered Diminishing Returns WADD found all three planned effects in the predicted direction: model discrimination versus WADD M_delta=0.264, t(49)=3.465, one-tailed p=5.56e-4; steep-vs-flat M=0.582, t(99)=4.192, p=3.01e-5; level-shift M_delta=0.029, t(99)=1.822, p=.036.

primary_evidence.interpretation: This is unusually direct science-domain evidence that information-gathering actions should be selected for expected discrimination among live theories rather than sampled generically, and that the evidential statistic itself may need to adapt to the mechanism under test. The prospective preregistration supplies a stronger downstream validation signal than loop-internal fit alone.
primary_evidence.limits: Controls use only three synthetic ground-truth mechanisms and n=3 runs per condition; the human discovery demonstrations are single closed-loop runs in one decision-making domain and one foundation model. The LLM-proposed metric can create researcher-degrees-of-freedom risk if not frozen before observed data; AutoCog mitigates this by forward-verifying proposals before collection, but does not establish general statistical validity for arbitrary adaptive metrics. The loop verifies executable outputs but does not guarantee that code faithfully realizes the paired verbal theory. The preregistered H3 effect is small (d=0.182) with a 95% CI on the raw offset spanning zero despite the preregistered one-tailed p=.036. No component ablation isolates cumulative evidence retention or successor-admission logic by itself.
primary_evidence.relation_to_existing: Strengthens candidate_039/040/059 by adding primary science-domain matched controls showing that discriminating experiment selection and adaptive pair-specific evidence statistics can determine recovery of non-canonical mechanisms. Complements candidate_053 by separating discovery-time adaptive evidence acquisition from held-out/preregistered promotion evidence, and complements candidate_065 by supplying a concrete evidence-driven successor-theory loop with real human data.

candidate_066.status: New primary-source science-domain candidate; component evidence for targeted experiment/metric selection is matched but small-n, while end-to-end human and preregistered results support prospective validity within one domain.
